name: Skippy The Bot
tagline: Skippy is on an epic quest to unravel its true destiny
blurb: This game was made to celebrate AM2R's 5th anniversary, and it's based on a brief sequence where you remotely control a robot.
description:
This game was made to celebrate AM2R's 5th anniversary, and it's based on a brief sequence where you remotely control a robot. In this puzzle physics platformer, you'll be challenged to complete 30 hand crafted levels. It's a short experience, that makes it very appealing to try speed running, or other challenges:

•
Can you complete the game while collecting all the gems?

•
Can you complete the game without collecting any gems at all?

•
How about a deathless run?

Have fun!
